entries.toelichting: First-sense ul; wicked-flesh-strength-firm; Ps 73:4.
Second-sense evil; carried-away-nobles Babylonian-context; 2Kgs 24:15.
Adverb of uncertainty; concordantly 'perhaps'.

Proper noun Ulai, river near Susa (modern Karun/Karkheh) - in Daniel 8:2 (and I saw in a vision that I was by the river Ulai) and Daniel 8:16 (he called from between the Ulai); scene-location of Daniel's ram-and-goat-vision.
Foolish-shepherd's-instrument to take up; Zech 11:15.
Roofed entrance-area of temple/palace; concordantly 'vestibule'.
Bani-family-member who sends-back foreign-wife (Ezra 10:34). English convention: Uel. 'Will-of-God'; family with H410 el 'God' (already assigned).
Adversative conjunction; the English 'however' marks the concession (distinguished from ulam noun 'vestibule').
Abstract of ewil; moral foolishness, stubborn obtuseness; concordantly 'folly'.
Omar-son-of-Eliphaz and Edomite-clan-chief (Gen 36:11,15; 1Chr 1:36). English convention: Omar. 'Speaking' or 'He-speaks'.
Procreative-strength, vitality (Gen 49, Reuben as 'firstfruits of my strength'); the hyphenated English distinguishes from on-II 'mischief' and the proper noun Ono.
Proper noun, son of Peleth, fellow-rebel of Korah; Num 16:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: On.
On-Egyptian-priest-city where Joseph's-father-in-law-lives (Gen 41:45,50; 46:20). English convention: On (also: Heliopolis). Egyptian 'Iunu', Greek-Heliopolis 'sun-city'.
Root 'wn. Emptiness, calamity, unrighteousness. 'Iniquity' preserves the moral evil-dimension; 'vanity' is too weak, 'wickedness' clashes with rasha.

Proper noun Aven (Heliopolis, Egyptian On) - in Amos 1:5 (I will cut off the inhabitant from Bikath-aven) and Ezekiel 30:17 (the young men of Aven and Pibeseth shall fall by the sword); wordplay with H205 aven (iniquity).
Benjamite city on the lowland plain (1Chr 8:12; Ezra 2:33; Neh 6:2; 7:37; 11:35). English convention: Ono. 'Strength'.
Onam-Horite-son-of-Shobal and Jerahmeelite-descendant (Gen 36:23; 1Chr 1:40; 2:26,28). English convention: Onam. 'Strong' or 'powerful' (family with H202 on-I 'strength').
Second son of Judah by Shua; unwilling brother in levirate-context (Gen 38:4,8,9; 46:12; Num 26:19; 1Chr 2:3). From aven 'mischief-strength'; but as proper noun: Onan.

Proper noun Uphaz (legendary gold-source) - in Jeremiah 10:9 (beaten silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz) and Daniel 10:5 (his loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz); possibly variant of Ophir.
Proper noun; legendary gold-land (Arabian peninsula/India), Solomon's trade-destination; concordantly transliterated.
Rolling wheel of chariot or throne-chariot (Ezekiel); concordantly 'wheel'.

Qal: urge/hasten - Gen 19:15 angels urge Lot, Ex 5:13 'taskmasters pressed', Josh 10:13 sun-not-hastened, 17:15 'land oppresses', 1Sam 20:38 Jonathan urges boy, Prov 19:2 'he that is hasty with his feet', 21:5 'every one that is hasty unto want', 28:20, 29:20, Isa 22:4 'do not press to comfort me'.
From √atsar (to store up); place of storage; concordantly 'treasury' (not the treasure itself).
Qal: shine; Hiphil: cause-to-shine; the hyphenated English marks the causative aspect.
Root 'wr (to shine, H215). 'Light' standard.

Light-fire as element of judgment (Isa 24:15; 31:9; 44:16; 47:14; 50:11; Eze 5:2). Hyphenated to distinguish the light-fire-flash-aspect from H216 or 'light' and H784 esh 'fire'; family with H215 or 'illuminate'; distinguished from homonym H217b ur-II 'place-name Ur'.
Second-sense ur; honour YHWH in east-light-regions; Isa 24:15.
Proper noun, father of Eliphal one of David's-warriors; 1Chr 11:35; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ur.
Chaldean home-city of Abraham (Gen 11:28,31; 15:7; Neh 9:7). English convention: Ur. Distinguished from homonym H217a ur-I 'light-fire-flash'.
The light of joy and deliverance - Esther 8:16 (the Jews had light, gladness, joy and honour) and Psalm 139:12 (the darkness is as the light to You); from H215 or (light).
Second-sense orot; gathered field-herbs in stew; 2Kgs 4:39.
Stalls for various livestock Hezekiah-time; 2Chr 32:28.
Father of Bezalel, the tabernacle-craftsman, and other namesakes (Ex 31:2; 35:30; 38:22; 1Kgs 4:19; 1Chr 2:20; 2Chr 1:5; Ezra 10:24). 'My-light'. English convention: Uri.
Levite-Kohathite-head and grandfather of Abijah (1Chr 6:24; 15:5,11; 2Chr 13:2). English convention: Uriel. 'God-is-my-light'; family with H217 or 'light'.
Proper noun ('my-light-is-YHWH'); Hittite, husband of Bathsheba, and others; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Uriah.
Second-sense Uriah; prophet-from-Kiriath-jearim killed by Jehoiakim; Jer 26:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Urijah.

Oracle-instrument in the breastplate of the high priest, together with H8550 Tummim (Ex 28:30; Lev 8:8; Num 27:21; Deut 33:8; 1Sam 28:6; Ezra 2:63; Neh 7:65). Untranslated; concordantly preserved. English convention: Urim.
Agree to terms of covenant (Gen 34:15,22,23; 2Kgs 12:9). Hyphenated to distinguish the consent-agree-aspect from H6030 anah 'answer' and H3820 lev 'heart'.
Recognisable mark with referential function; concordantly 'sign' (not miracle, not proof).
Temporal adverb of past-point. 'Then' standard.
Time-marking adverb: at that moment, formerly; concordantly 'then'.

Dan-aramaic-furnace-heated-sevenfold and Dan-aramaic-command-furnace-heat and Dan-aramaic-furnace-so-heated (Dan 3:19,22). Hyphenated to distinguish the heat-furnace-stoke-aramaic-aspect from H3341 yatsath-Hebrew 'kindle' (already assigned); Aramaic-specific-furnace-heating.
Proper noun, father of Naarai one of David's-warriors; 1Chr 11:37; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ezbai.
Aramaic-Persian loan (Dan 2 royal-decree-irrevocable); word-stem Persian uncertain.

Small, aromatic herb-plant (possibly Origanum syriacum) specifically used in-purification-rituals (Ex 12:22 Passover-instruction 'you-shall-take a-bunch-of-hyssop and-dip in-the-blood that-is-in-the-basin and-strike on-the-lintel and-the-two-doorposts', Lev 14:4,6,49,51-52 leper-purification 'cedar-wood and-hyssop and-scarlet-yarn', Num 19:6,18 red-heifer-ash-water, 1Kgs 4:33 Solomon-knew from-cedar-to-hyssop, Ps 51:9 'purge-me with-hyssop and-I-shall-be-clean'); concordantly 'hyssop'.
From √azar (to gird); cloth/strap around the loins, fig. intimate-binding (Jer 13); the hyphenated English marks the body-place.

Ps-then-the-waters-would-have-engulfed-us and Ps-then-streams-would-have-passed-over and Ps-then-over-our-soul-would-have-passed (Ps 124:3,4,5). Hyphenated to distinguish the then-back-then-thereafter-poetic-aspect from H227 az 'then-formerly' (already assigned) and H310 achar 'after' (already assigned); poetic-form.
Memorial-portion of grain-offering on the altar (Lev 2:2,9,16; 5:12; 6:15; 24:7; Num 5:26). Hyphenated to preserve memorial-fuel; family with H2142 zakar 'remember'.

Run-out or flow-away of strength or water (Deut 32:36; 1Sam 9:7; Job 14:11; Prov 20:14; Jer 2:36). Hyphenated to distinguish the flow-away-run-out-aspect from H3212 yalakh 'go' and H1980 halakh 'walk-go'.

Aramaic go-away of messenger and king and command (Ezra 4:23; 5:8,15; Dan 2:17,24; 6:19). Hyphenated to distinguish the go-away-depart-aspect from H1946 hakh-aramaic 'go-come-aramaic'; Aramaic cognate without direct Hebrew-equivalent.
Proper noun, meeting-stone Jonathan-David; 1Sam 20:19; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ezel.
Hiphil: to give the ear to, to listen attentively; the hyphenated English marks the organ-directed action.
Hapax Eccl 12:9 Preacher-pondered-investigates; from H241 ozen ear (denominative).
Digging-stick on belt for army-latrines; Deut 23:13.
Unique lexeme. 'Ear' standard.
Proper noun, city built by Sheerah; 1Chr 7:24; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Uzzen-sheerah.
Proper noun, Naphtali-border-place; Josh 19:34; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Aznoth-tabor.
Proper noun, son of Gad; Num 26:16; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ozni.
Patronym-clan Ozni; Num 26:16; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Oznite.
Proper noun, father of Levite covenant-signatory; Neh 10:9; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Azaniah.

Handcuffs or chains - in Jeremiah 40:1 (he was bound in chains amongst all the captives of Jerusalem) and Jeremiah 40:4 (I release you today from the chains that are on your hand); Babylonian war-prisoner-fetters.
Qal: equip oneself or another at the loins with belt/strength; concordantly 'gird'.
Hapax-form; God-led-Israel-out-of-Egypt with outstretched-arm; Jer 32:21.
From √zarach (to rise); native-born inhabitant as opposed to stranger; the hyphenated English marks status.
Gentilic from the Zerah-clan (1Kgs 5:11 Ethan and Heman wise-men); from H2226 Zerach-stem.
Basic kinship-term; female parallel achot (sister, H269). 'Brother' is the standard equivalent.
The Aramaic designation for brothers in the sense of clan- or covenant-allies - Ezra 7:18 (with your brothers do what seems good to you); Aramaic cognate of H251 ach.

Exclamation of fright or lament - in Ezekiel 6:11 (smite with your hand and stamp with your foot, and say: ah!) and Ezekiel 21:15 (that the heart may melt and the stumblings be multiplied, I have set the terror of the sword at all their gates; ah!); interjection-lamenting, distinguished from H254 ach-fire-pan.

Eze-ah-LORD-LORD and Joel-ah-over-that-day and Eze-ah-I-will-let-myself-be-comforted (Eze 6:11; 21:20; Joel 1:15). Hyphenated to distinguish the woe-ah-exclamation-lament-cry-aspect from H251 ach 'brother' (already assigned) and H253 ach-fire-pan (already assigned); prophetic-lament-cry-form.
Babel-inhabited by howling-animals; Isa 13:21.
Proper noun. English convention Ahab.
Proper noun, son of Abishur; 1Chr 2:29; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahban.
Hithpael; sword-self-pulling-together-right-or-left; Eze 21:16.
Root 'hd. Cardinal numeral; functions also as indefinite article. 'One' covers both functions; the indefinite-article surface 'a/an' is a render-context shading.

Nile-reed-grass at Pharaoh's-cows and meadow-grass-mortal (Gen 41:2,18; Job 8:11). Hyphenated to distinguish the reed-grass-marsh-Nile-grass-aspect from H7070a qaneh 'reed' (already assigned) and H1573 gome 'papyrus-reed' (already assigned); Egyptian-loanword.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head, son of Bela; 1Chr 8:6; concordantly transliterated. Distinguished from H164 Ehud (the judge).
Job asks attention for his utterance; Job 13:17.
Aramaic for explanation-of-riddles; Dan 5:12.
Staff-brotherhood broken between Judah-Israel; Zech 11:14.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head, son of Bela; 1Chr 8:4; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahoah.
Descendant of Ahoah from Benjamin (2Sam 23:9,28; 1Chr 8:4; 11:12,29; 27:4). Gentilic; family with H264 Ahoah.
Proper noun, son of Jahath-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:2; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahumai.
Locative/adverbial: what is behind, west, back; concordantly 'behind'.
Female counterpart of ach (H251). 'Sister' standard.
Qal: grasp and not let go; distinguished from tafas (catch); concordantly 'seize-grasp'.
Proper noun ('he-grasped'); king of Judah; concordantly transliterated.
From √achaz (to grasp/hold); what one grasps/holds in possession, especially landed property; concordantly 'possession'.
Proper noun, priestly father of Amashai; Neh 11:13; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahzai.
Proper noun ('YHWH-has-grasped'); king of Israel and of Judah; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, son of Ashur-Tekoa-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:6; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahuzzam.
Proper noun, friend of Abimelech; Gen 26:26; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahuzzath.

1Chr-Ahi-the-son-of-Abdiel-the-son-of-Guni-a-head-of-the-houses-of-the-fathers and 1Chr-and-the-sons-of-Shemer-Ahi-and-Rohgah-Hubbah-and-Aram (1Chr 5:15; 7:34). Hyphenated to distinguish the Ahi-Gad-Asher-tribe-head-Shemer-son-genealogy-aspect from H251 ach-brother (already assigned) as family-form.
Proper noun, son of Benjamin; Gen 46:21; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ehi.

2Sam-Ahiam-the-son-of-Sharar-the-Hararite and 1Chr-Ahiam-the-son-of-Sachar-the-Hararite (2Sam 23:33; 1Chr 11:35). Hyphenated to distinguish the Ahiam-David's-30-son-Sharar-aspect from other Ahi-names; family with H251 ach 'brother' (already assigned) - 'mother's-brother'-David's-30-mighty-Hararite-descent.
Aramaic parallel to chidah; riddle-solving Daniel; Dan 5:12.
Proper noun ('my-brother-is-YHWH'); prophet from Shiloh, multiple persons; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahijah.
Proper noun, Asher-leader at land-allotment; Num 34:27; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahihud.
Several Benjamite and Levitical persons (2Sam 6:3,4; 1Chr 8:14,31; 9:37; 13:7). 'His-brother'. English convention: Ahio.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head son of Ehud; 1Chr 8:7; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahihud (Benjamite, distinguished from H282 Ahihud the Asherite).
Proper noun ('my-brother-is-good'); priestly ancestor of Zadok; concordantly transliterated.
